name: Workhorse operations
responsibility: The four things the coordinator may ask of a workhorse, one at a time: delegate, steer, inspect, manage its queue
description: The coordinator's one door in, and each workhorse has its own. Its operations run one after another, so two coordinator effects never interleave on one thread, and each mutation is staged, settled and reported under an epoch operation. A delegation starts a turn on an idle workhorse and joins the queue of an active one Archboard created. An operation follows its workhorse turn to the end even after a voice start replaces the coordinator that asked for it; only the current coordinator may start one.
